plan.baseline_parity_required: First zh-stability / ono_anna / seed 196 / temperature 0.7 must match the existing original-SDK failure tokens and PCM SHA exactly
plan.outputs: Full per-case token and PCM hashes, EOS, duration, wall time; original PCM remains private
plan.pairing: Same text, voice and fixed seed; baseline 0.7 immediately followed by candidate 0.9
plan.promotion_requirements: No candidate is promoted from this diagnostic alone. Any production change must retain interface/cancellation/update checks, pass the original strict two-hour target gate and fixed corpus regression, and obtain human listening evidence
plan.purpose: Predeclared paired TTS diagnostic; no production parameter change or quality acceptance
plan.quality_followup: After this process actually terminates, transcribe every output with the unchanged ASR Helper; split outputs above 24 seconds and retain every segment. Roundtrip errors combine TTS and ASR and do not prove human listening quality
plan.stop_rule: Complete all predeclared cases regardless of EOS outcome; stop only on parity failure, process error or resource/time bounds
